review: [hrv-time-domain-taskforce-1996] Task Force time-domain HRV requires that ectopic/artefactual beats be identified and edited before analysis; include a quality/ectopy op (ecgQualityCheck or ecgRRcorrect) in the pipeline. The gate checks that such an op is present and reports the measured ectopic burden for human review — it does not itself certify that the burden is acceptable.
